messages:
Maria G.: quick heads-up — noticed 3 broken embeds in the KB page 'serving/edge-cache' (images returning 403). Also the command snippet still uses `--cache=disabled` which is outdated. pinging folks who own that area.
Maria G.: repro: open https://kb.redwood.ai/serving/edge-cache -> scroll to 'Setup' -> images missing.
docs-bot: [scan-alert] KB scan flagged 3 media 403s and a deprecated flag in codeblocks (rule: kb-media-403, kb-depr-flag). See report: https://internal.redwood.ai/kb-scans/scan-2026-03-18-94
Ashley: I can take this one. small fix: update image path to S3 redirect and change `--cache=disabled` -> `--cache=auto`. will open PR.
Tanya: thanks Ashley — quick question: is `--cache=auto` safe for Dedicated customers or should we gate behind a config?
Ashley: good q. For the snippet here it's just the local dev quickstart, so `auto` is fine. I added a short inline note: "for Dedicated, set explicit policy".
Ashley: opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/kb/pull/482 — fixes image paths + updates snippet + updates frontmatter metadata (owner: @Ashley). PR includes a tiny migration script to rehost missing thumbnails.
Sam: can you also update the doc-metadata in the YAML at top (tags: caching, serving) so the search picks it up? I got a ping from support.
Ashley: yep will add tags and bump `last_reviewed` date.
Maria G.: thanks — once PR merges can you add the doc to the weekly docs-sweep board (card: kb-serve-edge-cache) so PMs can verify?
Ashley: will do. marking as claimed. :white_check_mark:
Tanya: LGTM, thx.
Maria G.: small request — when you update the snippet please keep both the old and new CLI variants in a short note, e.g.:
```
# old (deprecated)
redwood serve --cache=disabled
# new
redwood serve --cache=auto
```
so users searching for old flags still find it.
Ashley: good call, added that to the PR diff.
Maria G.: perfect — closing the loop, thanks everyone!
